The weighted campus energy balance calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the risk-assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.85 across one trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 1.13s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should verify edge cases in the weighting distribution to maintain the 1.0 mean reward.
